 Suriya's Scene Set to Surpass PS-1 in Kerala on Day 7, Eyes Coolie's Top 5 Spot and Vikram's Lifetime Record 
 By Christa Lincy · 12 Nov 2026, 1:54 PM IST
 Chennai, November 12, 2026: A place among Kerala's five highest-grossing Tamil films is usually reserved for the industry's biggest stars and releases that enjoy a long theatrical run. Suriya's Scene is now threatening to enter that company within its opening week itself. The Jithu Madhavan directorial is just one step away from overtaking Mani Ratnam's Ponniyin Selvan: Part 1 (PS-1), with Rajinikanth's Coolie looking increasingly vulnerable as the second weekend approaches.
 According to Sacnilk's state-wise box office tracking, Scene has collected ₹22.45 crore gross in Kerala after six days. The film needs just ₹47 lakh more to surpass PS-1's lifetime total, a target it should comfortably achieve on Thursday. Even a relatively modest ₹1.50 crore gross on Day 7 would take its cumulative collection to ₹23.95 crore, moving it to sixth place among the state's highest-grossing Tamil films.

 Ramayana and Scene Dominate Diwali Box Office with 1100 Crore+ Worldwide Gross in Just One Week 
 By Sunit Jangir · 11 Nov 2026, 9:08 PM IST
 Mumbai, November 11, 2026: Diwali 2026 has delivered a major box office boost for Indian cinema, with Namit Malhotra's Ramayana and Suriya's Scene combining for an estimated 1100+ crore worldwide gross. Released just a day apart, the two films have capitalised on the festive season to attract substantial theatrical audiences across domestic and international markets. Their simultaneous success has made the holiday period particularly rewarding for both Bollywood and Kollywood.
